researchEvidence.note: CIB's official consumer page links separate searches for registered roofing contractors and for building/home inspector, electrical, mechanical, and plumbing licensees.

CIB states that it regulates plumbing, electrical, mechanical, roofing, building and construction inspectors, and home inspectors, and that general contractors are not currently required to have a state license in Oklahoma.
CIB's mechanical contractor page lists HVAC/R, refrigeration, natural gas piping, process piping, sheet metal, and ground source piping contractor license categories.

blocker.summary: No stable, documented machine-readable official interface is currently suitable for an offline-tested adapter.
